reviews.text: I enjoyed this product and have repurchased it. It cleanses my face really well and allows my foam cleanser to lather well. It doesn't feel drying at all, but my skincare regimen does focus on hydration.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意呢件產品，已經回購。洗得乾淨，仲幫到我嘅泡沫洗面奶起泡。完全唔覺乾，不過我嘅護膚程序本身就注重保濕。

reviews.text: I've been using this Korean skincare product for a few weeks now, and I'm really impressed with the results. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving any greasy residue. My skin feels more hydrated, smoother, and has a noticeable glow. It's gentle, even on sensitive skin, and has become a staple in my daily routine. Highly recommend for anyone looking to upgrade their skincare
reviews.zh: 用咗呢款韓國護膚品幾星期，效果真係好滿意。質地輕盈，吸收得快，唔會留低油笠感。皮膚感覺更保濕、更滑，明顯有光澤。連敏感肌都用得，溫和，已經成為我日常必備。強烈推薦畀想升級護膚嘅人。

reviews.text: I bought several mixsoon products to do a skincare routine and i have two products that are undoubtedly my favorites: bean cream and bean cleansing. I like to do a double cleansing, so this product is the best. I like the feeling on my skin and how soft it leaves my face when I wash it.
reviews.zh: 買咗幾件 mixsoon 嘅產品嚟做護膚程序，其中有兩件無可置疑係我最鍾意：豆乳面霜同豆乳卸妝。我鍾意做雙重潔面，所以呢件產品最啱我。鍾意佢喺皮膚上嘅感覺，洗完面後塊面軟綿綿。

reviews.text: Ame este aceite limpiador, es un gran complemento para la doble limpieza. Yo lo combino con un gel espumosos de heimish, después esencia de frijol y en la mañana el protector solar de centella asiática de la misma marca. Lo recomiendo para piel grasa.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢支卸妝油，係雙重潔面嘅好拍檔。我會配搭 heimish 嘅泡沫 gel，之後用豆乳精華，朝早就用返同品牌嘅積雪草防曬。推薦畀油性肌。

reviews.text: This cleansing oil is very good. It removes makeup and dirt well. My skin feels clean and soft after using it. It does not make my skin dry. I like the texture and the light smell. I use it every day.
reviews.zh: 呢支卸妝油好好用。卸妝同去污都乾淨。用完皮膚感覺清爽又柔軟。唔會令皮膚乾燥。鍾意佢嘅質地同淡淡嘅香味。每日都用。

reviews.text:
Transforming! I bought this for a friend with clogged pores and sagging dehydrated skin. I wish I had a before and after. They are also using the serum. 
Day and night, they looked visually different
reviews.zh: 煥膚級效果！買畀一位毛孔堵塞、皮膚鬆弛又缺水嘅朋友。真希望有 before 同 after 對比。佢都有用支精華。日頭夜晚，視覺上都明顯唔同咗。

reviews.text: Good at taking off makeup, this oily has a very watery consistency and is very light, no like the usual thick oil consistency that most oil cleansers have. It smells nice too, but it’s not very effective in removing mascara
reviews.zh: 卸妝效果好，呢支油嘅質地好水、好輕，唔似一般卸妝油咁厚身。味道都幾好聞，不過卸睫毛膏嘅效果就麻麻。

reviews.text:
I always hated the oil cleaning product smell but this one is really nicely scented. It helps remove all the make up. Best for sensitive skin and prone acne skin. I never had pimple up (unless in period week) after using this cleanser. I do not use it for daily (b/c I do not wear makeup everyday).

I definitely will purchase this one again.
reviews.zh:
我一直都好怕卸妝油嘅味道，但呢支嘅香味真係好正。幫到手卸晒所有妝。最適合敏感肌同容易爆瘡嘅肌膚。用咗之後基本上冇再爆瘡（經期嗰星期例外）。唔係日日用（因為唔係日日化妝）。

一定會再回購。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
